decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the accepted first-mint exception for both the random ticket and $5 commission.
A same-message MODIFY already excludes the first mint from expected ticket and commission totals because no prior NFT could receive them.
The referral-reward exception does not change whether a primary or fiat purchase must mint and deliver the NFT.
The first-mint referral commission exception does not alter optional tipping or its separate post-mint transaction.
The exception does not change payment-currency disclosure or selection behavior.
The accepted reward-allocation exception does not change the USDC approval-to-mint flow.
The exception does not alter the rule that success feedback appears only after an actual mint.
The client characterized the exception as a completed one-off with no future effect, so it does not necessarily require changing prospective FAQ messaging.
The first-mint referral exception does not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, wallet provisioning, or mint delivery.
The reward exception does not alter ETH conversion, exact-output swap, refund, or shortfall behavior.
The landing-page state describes coded-referral commissions and prize messaging and is not changed by this one-off no-prior-holder exception.
The matched first-mint terminology is incidental; the exception does not affect the badge set, icons, count, or layout.
